text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads up — onboarding webhook & embeddings index calls in eu-west-1 are seeing 502/503s for a subset of accounts. Not system-wide but blocking some new customer onboarding flows. I'm going to draft a short customer-facing update. @Ethan can you pull the impacted list?

Ethan Patel: Pulling now. running query across dedicated-pools and hosted routing logs. will post CSV. preliminary count ~22 accounts (5 trials, 17 production).

Liam Ortiz: Root cause summary: config drift during autoscaler change caused routing to fallback to a model variant that doesn't support the new batching mode for embeddings. When bursts hit that pool we saw transient 502/503s. Patch to routing selection merged and deployed ~10m ago.

Nora Blake: Status update: restarted the reindex background job on the affected pools, KV cache warmup is running. Error rate on embeddings pipeline down from ~18% to ~3% in the last 8m. Continuing to monitor.

Maya Chen: Draft customer note (short, plain):
"Hi — we experienced a transient issue in eu-west-1 that impacted embeddings and onboarding webhooks for a small set of customers between 2024-04-??T??:??Z - our team deployed a routing fix and restarted background jobs. Errors have dropped significantly and services are recovering. We're issuing a credit for the incident window and will follow up with a short RCA. If you see any ongoing failures please reply and we'll prioritize you."

Maya Chen: Proposed sent copy above — thoughts? want to include link to status page and offer contact?

Ethan Patel: add link to status and a note that AMs will be looped in for enterprise accounts. uploading CSV now: https://internal/files/impacted_customers_1718734567.csv

LegalBot: quick check — wording OK, don't admit systemic negligence. replace "we experienced" with "we observed" and add "no customer data was exposed" if accurate.

Liam Ortiz: Confirmed no data exposure. Change accepted. Also suggest adding one-sentence technical summary for AMs: "routing fallback to incompatible model variant under burst caused increased error rate; patch restored correct routing."

Maya Chen: Updated copy with Legal + tech:
"Hi — we observed a transient routing issue in eu-west-1 that affected embeddings and onboarding webhooks for a small set of customers between 2024-04-??T??:??Z. We deployed a routing patch and restarted background jobs; error rates have dropped and services are recovering. No customer data was exposed. We will issue a credit for the incident window and share a brief RCA. Your AM will follow up if you're an enterprise account. If you continue to see issues, please reply here or open a support ticket."

Nora Blake: monitoring — error rate currently 0.8% (rolling 5m). target <1% before ship. ETA ~5–10m.

Ethan Patel: suggest credit: 10% for affected trial and SMB accounts, enterprise handled case-by-case via AM.

Maya Chen: Agreed. Ethan pls prepare credit list and notify Billing.

DeployBot: routing-selection patch deployed to eu-west-1 at 1718734600 :shipit:

Nora Blake: baseline reached <1% at 1718734689. continuing 30m of observation.

Maya Chen: Final plan: send customer note in 10m (scheduled 1718734720) with CSV attached for internal teams. Ethan will prepare credits and notify Billing, AMs will get the technical one-liner and RCA follow-up. Nora will post final "all clear" here once observation window completes.

Ethan Patel: copying CS send template into internal queue, prepping billing run.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone :ok_hand: will post the public note and ping affected account owners.

Nora Blake: if we see a regression we'll open a priority bridge. otherwise closing on-call actions after observation window.

Maya Chen: closing thread once billing & send are confirmed.
